# codex-utils-pty

Vendored PTY and pipe process helpers from OpenAI Codex, with local adaptations.
See [third-party notices](../../THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md) for origin and licensing.

See [src/lib.rs](src/lib.rs) for the current API.

Run the package tests from the core repository root:

```bash
cargo test -p codex-utils-pty --all-targets --locked
```
